ActExpr.description:
An action inside an expression: the action forms that may nest, with
expression arguments.

ActKind.description:
What an [`Expr::Act`] does. `yield` and `cancel` stay statement
actions.

oneOf.description: Calls a function and yields what it returns.
Runs one effect and yields its result, decoded as `result`.
Starts a task running a function and yields its handle.
Waits on the task handle that is its one argument.
Waits on the list of task handles that is its one argument.
Gives other ready tasks their turn.
Cancels the task handle that is its one argument.
Awaits its one argument by the await policy (`K-TASK-026`).

Action.description:
An action as the whole right-hand side of its own statement, its
arguments atoms (`K-FORM-001`); [`Expr::Act`] nests one in an
expression.

oneOf.description: Calls a function and yields what it returns.
Runs one effect and yields its result, decoded as `result`.

then_yield.description:
Whether the task takes one more turn of the ready queue once
the outcome is in, before it continues (`K-TASK-005`).

oneOf.description: Waits on one task handle.
Waits on a list of task handles.
Lets every other ready task run first.
Starts a task running a function and yields its handle.
Raises a cancellation in a task at its current wait.

Awaits a value by its dialect's await policy: a library function
that takes the value, waits as the dialect's `await` does, and
yields what the `await` gives (`K-TASK-026`).

state.description:
The state its occurrences give it, `None` with none. A run commits
occurrences for its effects and its waits only (FIG-6810). A library
call receives its body's effects through their authored `origin`; the
occurrences keep their library identities. A pure call, and a `sleep`
that never parked, has no occurrence of its own. A
process's live feed may report one as entered, never as completed
or failed. A run that failed names the site that raised in its
terminal failure's `UncaughtError` cause: a wait action, or the
statement a library call raised in, whose actions are the nodes with
that `statement`.

ActionObservation.description:
Outcome data stays on the exact occurrence the observer supplies, never on
every action of its statement. `T` can retain the host's typed result/cause.

origin.description:
The authored statement supplied by the effect request. This is display
attribution; `identity` keeps the actual performing unit and occurrence.

ActionRole.description: Whose code or which outside party an action reaches.

oneOf.description:
A `perform`: a request the host answers, such as a tool call. Each
run of it is one effect occurrence, named by its `EffectId`.

A `sleep`: a timed wait. Each run of it is an effect occurrence too,
which no host answers.

A call or `spawn` of the document's own code: a declared function, or
the closure or function reference a variable holds.

A call or `spawn` of a library function, or an `await` through its
dialect's policy: the dialect's or the kernel's code. `applies`
names a closure of the document it runs.

A `join`, `join_many`, `cancel` or `yield`: coordination among the
run's tasks.

ActionState.description:
What an occurrence of an action did. `Recovered` is a failure whose
error a `catch` took, so the run went on (FIG-6817): the process
overlay's `recovered` row. `Failed` is a failure nothing recovered from.

applies.description:
The may-call set of a call or `spawn` through a value, and of the
document callables a library callee applies, deduplicated in site
order. Union all writes and follow aliases, parameters from document
call sites, collection members selected by kernel library bodies,
and library results (including wrappers that apply an input).
A closure is named by its expression's site, a [`CallableView::site`];
a declared function by `Site::new(unit, [])`, opened by [`derive_callable`].
Host inputs, perform results and native-only library results supply
no known callable. Session writes in this document are followed;
earlier session values, including saved functions, are underived:
[`WorkflowDocument`] supplies no session binding-to-function identities.
`Promise.all` and `asyncio.gather` only await tasks; the nested actions
that start their members name the closures, not the aggregate.

callee.description:
The statically named target of a call, spawn or perform.
Calls through values have no static callee name.

destination.description:
What an assignment of the action's result writes, when the action
is its whole right-hand side.

ordinal.description: The exact action issue ordinal, including actions folded into authored nodes.

performs.description:
Every canonical effect this action reaches, including calls through
library bodies and statically known declared callees. Derived from the
checker's effect derivation, in canonical order with duplicates removed.

result_type.description: A `perform`'s declared result, else the checker's facet.

role.description:
Whose code or which outside party the action reaches: what a host
picks the steps a person recognises by, never a callee's name.

static_duration.description:
A timer's statically known duration, after its pinned helper's conversion.
Whole milliseconds, represented as seconds and nanoseconds in JSON.
Absent for computed arguments, unrecognized helpers and invalid literals.
This is an authored duration, not a running timer's remaining time.

binding.description: The binding a variable argument reads.

expression.description:
The argument as the document writes it. A statement's own action
writes a variable or a literal.

name.description: The parameter or builtin operand the kernel names here.

site.description:
The argument's node, for an action nested in an expression: the
expression an edit replaces. A statement's own action writes its
arguments in place, with no node of their own.

type.description:
That parameter's type; `any` for an untyped declared parameter or
when no signature names one.

AssignOrder.description:
The order an assignment to a member evaluates its parts in
(`K-EVAL-003`): each dialect's own, written in the document.

oneOf.description:
The right-hand side, then the place's target, then its index, as
Python assigns.

The place's target, then its index, then the right-hand side, as
TypeScript assigns. Only a member is written in this order, and its
right-hand side is an expression: an action there is nested.

Atom.description: An argument of an action: a variable or a literal, never a computation.

assigned.description: Some statement assigns it after its declaration.

block.description: The block it is declared in.

id.description: The binding's id in this derivation.

produced_by.description:
The `perform` whose reply a `let` nothing reassigns holds: the site
of the effect's action in [`Dataflow::actions`], for TypeScript's
`const r = await tools.x(...)` and Python's `r = await tools.x(...)`,
and for an `await` of a promise or task that only performs it.
Absent when the value is computed from a reply, such as one of its
fields: that value comes from the code. Derived, never stored.

type.description: The checker's facet of what it holds.

uses.description: Every node that reads it, in document order.

CallablePresentation.description:
How a function a closure makes is started from outside its run: the
signature it is started under, how the dialect holds the function as a
value, and how the entry calls it.

CallableView.description: A lexical callable is projected once, independently of its invocations.

Callee.description: What a call or a `spawn` runs.

oneOf.description: A declared function of the document, by name.
The closure or function reference a variable holds.

exports.description:
Every visible Export backed by this identity in the retained
Packages. A private definition has no Exports.

binding.description: The variable the caught error value is bound to.

Closure.description:
A function value written in place. It shares the variables of the scope
that defines it (`K-CLO-001`); which ones is derived, never written.

function.description: The anonymous body's own identity, local to the defining Document.

ComparisonView.description:
A condition that is one comparison of values a host can name. A binary
comparison reads `left` then `right`; `contains` holds when `left`
holds `right`, `starts_with` and `ends_with` when `left` begins or ends
with `right`. Each holds under its dialect's own equality, order and
truth: TypeScript's `===` and Python's `==` both read as `eq`.

oneOf.description:
The condition holds when its operand is false (falsy, in a dialect
with truthiness).

ControlArm.description:
A control retains empty arms and the distinction between body entries and
header actions. Header actions live under `header`, not before the control.

comparison.description:
The comparison a condition decides, read through a variable the
lowering bound to it in the statement right before the control and
that nothing else reads or reassigns. Absent when the condition is
not one comparison of parameters, literals, action results and
their record fields; never a guess.

Dataflow.description: What a variable is and where values flow in the entry.

actions.description:
Every action of the entry, a statement's own and each one nested in
an expression, in document order.

bindings.description: Every variable the entry declares, in declaration order.

expressions.description: Every expression of the entry, in document order.

parameters.description: The entry's parameters, by binding id.

returns.description: Every `return` and `finish` of the entry and the callable it ends.

optional.description: A caller may leave it out.

type.description:
The type the signature declares, not the binding's facet: `any` for
a function the document does not list as an entry.

name.description: The declared function; absent for the document's `main`.

params.description: Its parameters in order, as its signature declares them.

result.description: The result type its signature declares; `any` when it declares none.

result_facet.description:
What a call can end with: the union of the facets of the `return`s
and `finish`es that end this callable, except those that only follow
a statement that cannot complete, with `null` when the body can
complete and fall off its end. A lowering that spells falling off as an
explicit `return` (TypeScript's `return absent`) contributes that
return's facet instead.

ExecutionSiteView.description: One action and the coordinates it runs under.

loops.description:
The loops enclosing it inside its own function body, outermost
first.

statement.description: The statement it is part of: where its task stands while it waits.

within.description:
The innermost action it is an argument of, when it is nested in
one: in `call f(perform g() as Any)`, the call.

ExportName.description: A document Export, optionally a member of its TypeDef. Type members are not start selectors.

Expr.description:
An expression, evaluated within one statement. Only an [`Expr::Act`]
in it may pause the task (`K-EVAL-008`).

oneOf.description: Evaluates the condition, then only the selected branch.
Evaluates `value` before binding `name`, visible only in `body`.
Reads a field or an index.
Calls a library function that has a native implementation.

The embedder's clock, as a timestamp.
A float drawn by the embedder, uniform in `[0, 1)`.
An action nested in the expression: the statement may pause at it,
the operands it has already evaluated kept as the roles of its
continuation (`K-EVAL-008`).

available.description:
The bindings a name at this site resolves to, by id: one per name,
as lexical lookup finds it. A binding's own initializer cannot read
it.

references.description: The bindings it reads, by id. A closure's body is its own.

statement.description: The statement the expression belongs to.

type.description: The checker's facet of its value.

FlowEdge.description:
Canonical routes at exact member Sites, including finally-unwind routes.
Hosts must not invent a fallthrough between coarse groups.

FunctionRepresentation.description: How a dialect holds a function as a value.

oneOf.description: The closure itself.

A tuple whose first member is the text `tag` and whose member at
`callable` is the closure. The tuple crosses as one function value.

FunctionTarget.description: A convention helper local to this document or named by an explicit Import slot.

ImportSlot.description: A stable document-local Import coordinate. Names are diagnostic, never dispatch keys.

oneOf.description: Every member has ended, or the first failure.
Every member has ended.
The first member to end.
The first member to succeed.

LazyArm.description:
An expression alternative that guards an action's evaluation. These are
ancestry, not scheduling edges: static issue order never implies both arms run.

LineRange.description: Inclusive, one-based lines in an explicitly named printed lens.

oneOf.description: A reference to a declared function of the document.

Member.description: A field of a record or an index into a collection.

Name.description:
A variable, parameter or declared-function name.

Any text is a name; the kernel gives none of them meaning. Structural
validation refuses the empty name.

NodeCoverage.description: Coverage ready for a coarse node; loop iterations remain arm entries.

runs.description: Action issues, control starts, or code-group entries (first member only).

OperationSlot.description:
Disjoint operation namespaces. Helper bodies retain their own local import
slots, but execution identifies their declarations by content.

OperationUse.description:
One authored import or helper operation declaration in one immutable Link.
All dispatch, modes, recorded reads and waited outcomes use this identity.

optional.description:
The argument may be omitted, and is then absent (`K-FN-004`). No
required parameter follows an optional one.

Protocol.description:
A dialect's iteration protocol: the library functions a `for … via`
calls at its header, by identity (`K-ITER-005`). Each is listed in the
manifest as any library function a document reaches.

check.description:
Checks a map or a set against its size when the loop opened it and
the items it may still give, after each step; gives that budget
anew.

item.description: Takes what was walked and an item of it to the value bound.

next.description:
Steps a driver: an empty tuple when it is exhausted, else a tuple of
one item.

open.description:
Takes the iterated value to what the loop walks: a list, a tuple, a
map, a set or a text, which the loop's own cursor walks, or any
other value, a driver that `next` steps.

ReadableLens.description:
The requested readable source, or why no source is available.
Projection remains available when printing is refused.

ReadableRefusal.description: Typed printer refusal. The projection remains available without source.

RecordRest.description: A record either refuses, discards, or retains undeclared fields.

rest.description: What happens to fields not named in `fields` at a boundary.

callable.description:
What it ends: the enclosing closure, or the entry (a `finish`
always ends the entry).

expected_type.description: The result type that callable declares.

type.description: The checker's facet of the value.

Rhs.description: The right-hand side of a `let` or an assignment.

RunObservation.description: Per-run observation. Off is unobserved, never a zero count.

ScopeCoverage.description: One block of the entry and how often a run entered it.

entries.description: Arm selections, loop iterations, caught errors or function calls.

ScopeKind.description: What a block is the body of.

oneOf.description: The entry function's own body.
A closure's body.
An `if`'s block taken when its condition holds.

An `if`'s block taken when its condition does not hold, or a loop's
block run when it ends but by `break`.
A `for` loop's body.
A `while` loop's body.
A `try`'s guarded body.
A `try`'s `catch` body.
A `try`'s `finally` block.

ScopeView.description: One block of the entry and what opens it.

depth.description:
How many statements enclose this block inside the entry's body:
the same depth its statements carry.

ordinal.description: The document ordinal of this block, including nonempty blocks.

statement.description: The statement that opens this block; absent for the entry body.

Signature.description: What a function, an effect or an entry takes and returns.

Site.description:
A node's address: the code it belongs to and the chain of
[`Node::children`] indexes that reaches it from that code's body.

A site is derived from the document and is never written by a host
(`K-ID-004`). An empty chain addresses the body itself.

oneOf.description: A call of the runtime timer symbol, directly or through one wrapper.
An `await`: a call of its dialect's await policy.

SourceLanguage.description: The language of source, independent of a generated-source format version.

oneOf.description: Python calls carry positional arguments, keywords and the active exception.

StatementCoverage.description: One exact statement, action or while-test coordinate and its observed count.

runs.description: None is unobserved; Some(0) is an observed statement that did not run.

actions.description:
The sites of the statement's actions, its own and those nested in
its expressions, in the order a run issues them: an action's
arguments before it, left to right (`K-EVAL-001`). A run reports
each at its site. A closure's actions are its body's statements'.

block.description: The block the statement is in.

depth.description: How many statements enclose this one inside the entry's body.

ordinal.description: The document ordinal shared with run counts and replay paths.

readable.description: Lines in the available readable source, empty without that lens.

statement.description: The statement as the document writes it.

oneOf.description: Declares a variable in the enclosing block and gives it a value.

Writes a variable, a field or an index, evaluating its parts in
`order` (`K-EVAL-003`).

Removes a field of a record, an element of a list, an entry of a map
or a member of a set.
Evaluates an expression for effect and discards its result.

Runs `body` once per element of a collection, binding each to
`binding`, then `else_block` unless a `break` left the loop. With
`via`, a dialect's protocol opens the iterated value and steps it
(`K-ITER-005`).

metered.description:
Declared units at every continuation test, even in library code.
Zero leaves the loop covered by the call's completion formula.

oneOf.description:
Runs `body` while `condition` holds, then `else_block` unless a
`break` left the loop.

metered.description: As the declared loop charge of [`Stmt::For`].

oneOf.description:
Evaluates the value, unwinds source cleanup, then calls `policy`
with the surviving value. The policy may wait; its result returns
directly, outside the source function's handlers.
Ends the run with a result.
Ends the run as failed, with a reason.
Every value.

Every value `Any` admits that holds no closure, function reference,
dialect token holding one, task or handle anywhere in it: data, as a
JSON-schema slot describes it (`K-EFF-002`). It serves where `Any` is
expected; `Any` does not serve where it is.

An integer or a float. In an effect's result this is the bare number
the document's number policy decodes (`K-EFF-006`).
A tuple of exactly these member types.
A text that is one of these.
A closure or a function reference that takes and returns these.
A task handle whose task ends with this.
A handle of this host kind.
A value of any one of these types. Two or more, none itself a union.

Unit.description: The code a node belongs to.

oneOf.description: The document's `main`.
A declared function of the document.

The kernel-code body of an authored or build-owned library function.
Nested helper closures retain this owning identity and their site path.

Use.description: One read of a binding and the statement that contains it.

ValueRef.description:
A value a comparison reads: where it comes from, then the record fields
read from it, outermost first.

ValueSource.description: Where a compared value comes from.

oneOf.description: A parameter nothing assigns, by its binding in `dataflow`.

What the action at `site` yielded, held by a variable nothing
reassigns.

WorkflowCoverage.description: Statement starts, scope entries, action issues and while tests of one entry.

actions.description: Issues at exact action sites, independent of statement starts.

conditions.description: While header evaluations, including the final false test.

observation.description: The observation the counts came under; absent is an unobserved run.

scopes.description: Each block of the entry, in document order.

statements.description: Each statement of the entry, in document order.

WorkflowNode.description:
Identity is (view.document, body kind, block, site, last member). Ranges are
display metadata. Supporting statements and dataflow remain addressable.

folded.description:
Exact document action and statement sites folded into this authored
node. Execution counts and replay paths retain these coordinates.

ordinal.description: The node's authoritative count coordinate in RanCounts.

statement.description: The owning statement for actions/controls; first member for code.

WorkflowNodeBody.description: Kind-specific workflow data. The tag owns all variant payload fields.

members.description: Each statement has one carrier; secondary actions have no members.

WrittenSignature.description: The source spelling of a callable's public signature, without dialect state.

description: One entry of a document as a canvas reads it.

entry.description:
The callable the view opens: its declared signature and what a call
of it can end with.

execution_sites.description:
Every action of the document a run can report an occurrence at, in
node order. An entry may call and spawn any declared function, so
these are the sites of every unit.

scopes.description: Every block of the entry, including empty ones, in document order.

statements.description:
The entry's statements in document order, nested blocks after the
statement that holds them.
